tasks.title: Establish the architecture contract
tasks.acceptance: Define domain-specific solver and applicability boundaries; units and spatial/temporal/scale coupling; mass, energy, capture, disposal and lifecycle ledgers; uncertainty, identifiability, calibration and validation; versioned study/run/result contracts; negative outcomes; evaluator authority; scheduler recovery; plugin isolation; and evidence-based local-to-distributed scale triggers.

tasks.title: Establish the outcome and dependency roadmap
tasks.acceptance: Prepend Wave 0 without replacing Waves 1–8; connect the first analytic case to the original 24 tasks; state scientific gates, external reviewer/data/resource dependencies, scope cuts, stop conditions and evidence-driven replanning triggers.

tasks.title: Specify the executable next-work packet and validate the repository plan
tasks.acceptance: Specify BOX-001 with sufficient equations, synthetic values, intervention arms, invalid cases, artifacts and gates to begin ER-001 without inventing science; add a standard-library validator for unique IDs, status/wave constraints, dependencies, acyclicity, Wave 0 ordering, roadmap/task navigation and local Markdown links.

tasks.title: Specify the first pollutant scenario
tasks.acceptance: Define the synthetic catchment, particle classes, boundary conditions, analytic references and mass-accounting equation.

tasks.title: Review environmental data and rights
tasks.acceptance: Record exact source licenses, resolution, date coverage and missing variables; clearly label invented scenario inputs.

tasks.title: Build the experiment skeleton
tasks.acceptance: A CLI validates units and source/sink definitions; a hand-computable no-removal case passes.

tasks.title: Implement the reference flow/transport model
tasks.acceptance: Pass closed-box and open-boundary analytical cases with justified residual tolerances.

tasks.title: Implement source-reduction and capture policies
tasks.acceptance: Track captured and residual mass separately; no efficiency parameter can silently remove unaccounted mass.

tasks.title: Add disposal and lifecycle accounting
tasks.acceptance: Report the destination and energy assumptions for captured waste; detect double counting.

tasks.title: Create dry-weather and storm cases
tasks.acceptance: Use documented synthetic flow profiles with paired random inputs and all boundary conditions saved.

tasks.title: Compare three intervention strategies
tasks.acceptance: Show no intervention, source reduction and capture under equal resource assumptions, including invalid runs.

tasks.title: Export maps, balances and limitations
tasks.acceptance: Every figure derives from retained run data and labels simulation, source quality and unknown ecological effects.

tasks.title: Test particle and flow sensitivity
tasks.acceptance: Vary supported settling, fragmentation and flow parameters; identify rankings that change.

tasks.title: Validate resolution and numerical stability
tasks.acceptance: Run timestep/grid refinement and source/sink perturbations; reject unstable or nonconservative runs.

tasks.title: Create independent holdout scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Reserve public or synthetic confirmation conditions before search; state whether they validate numerics or environmental realism.

tasks.title: Integrate drainage and water-network adapters
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce an official example per chosen engine; do not silently equate pipe quality with treatment performance.

tasks.title: Add a restoration or urban-cooling case
tasks.acceptance: Document supported spatial scale, public inputs and ecological/thermal response limitations.

tasks.title: Add climate and lifecycle scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Separate historical data, projections and intervention assumptions; account for energy and emissions without geoengineering control.

tasks.title: Build source-backed hypotheses
tasks.acceptance: Require evidence, a measurable outcome and a failure condition for every proposed intervention.

tasks.title: Compare budgeted search methods
tasks.acceptance: Use equal simulation budgets and the same ecological constraints; retain all proposals and failed runs.

tasks.title: Confirm robust intervention tradeoffs
tasks.acceptance: Retest shortlisted strategies on holdouts; reject gains that only displace pollution across the modeled boundary.

tasks.title: Build a local watershed comparison view
tasks.acceptance: Accessible maps/tables expose units, waste destinations and uncertainty without implying real-world cleanup.

tasks.title: Add bounded batch workers
tasks.acceptance: Limit compute and storage; cancellation/recovery preserve completed evidence and mark partial studies.

tasks.title: Package portable environmental studies
tasks.acceptance: Another contributor reproduces a case offline with lawful fixtures and complete metadata.

tasks.title: Replicate a second catchment case
tasks.acceptance: An independent contributor reproduces a new scenario and documents transfer failures.

tasks.title: Review environmental and usability claims
tasks.acceptance: A domain reviewer checks conservation and ecological interpretation; a user completes a comparison/export workflow.

tasks.title: Prepare the research preview release
tasks.acceptance: Include limitations, known invalid cases, source notices and maintainer approval; no field-deployment claim.
